factor_specs.formula: 5-layer composite alpha: w_final = w_str1715_Iter31_LinTilt × m4_BOCPD_regime_scalar × β_AR_threshold_step × β_R05_tail_risk_sequential. Layer 1+2: Iter31 LinearTilt (λ=1.5, TOphi=3, ub=0.20) Z_aligned composite from Factor DB (Value+Quality+Momentum+Investor+Defense axes). Layer 3: M4 BOCPD posterior on KOSPI200 BM_Ret monthly (BULL/NORMAL m4_scalar=1.0, CAUTION=0.7, CRISIS=0.3). Layer 4: AR overlay K=5 universe, W=252 trading day window, threshold_step quantile mapping (β_AR=1.0 if AR<q70(0.4172), 0.7 if AR<q90(0.4502), 0.4 else). Layer 5: R05 Tail Risk sequential overlay (β_R05 ∈ {1.0 BULL/NORMAL, 0.5 CAUTION, 0.3 CRISIS}). Inherited 100% from STR_1715 Session 80 admit production (lro_sha frozen ad3d44...). Current 2026-05-18 state: m4 NORMAL × β_AR 0.7 × β_R05 1.0 = 70% risk + 30% cash.
